description: Add budget tracker component to compare estimated monthly bill with user's electricity budget
steps: Create src/components/BudgetTracker.tsx with: budget input field in ₹, progress bar comparing budget vs estimated monthly bill (cheapest plan), color-coded indicators (green < 80%, amber 80–100%, red > 100%), reset/update buttons
Integrate with localStorage: key 'wattwise_budget' to persist budget value
Add BudgetTracker to CalculatorPage (App.tsx) in appropriate location
Use formatINR for all currency displays in component
Ensure component is responsive and matches design system
acceptance_criteria: Users can set and update electricity budget in ₹
Progress bar shows budget vs estimated bill comparison
Color coding works correctly based on percentage
Component integrates smoothly with existing calculator UI
verification: Set budget and verify it saves to localStorage
Test progress bar updates with consumption changes
Verify color coding at different percentages
Refresh page and confirm budget persists
